plan: My value is $9. In a first-round game with no prior history, a reasonable strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. Other bidders likely have values between $0-$49. I want to win only if my bid is close to my true value. A bid around $8.5 minimizes my risk of overpaying while giving me a chance to win if others bid conservatively. This allows potential profit if my value is higher than the second-highest bid.

Other bidders likely have values between $0-$49. A bid around $35-$38 allows room for potential profit if I win, while not risking overpaying. I'll aim to bid just low enough to win but high enough to secure the prize.

Since values are randomly drawn between $0-$49, a rational strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. I'll aim to win by outbidding others while preserving profit margin.
